outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) with diagnosis of birth asphyxia
requirement for bag and mask ventilation (BMV)
cohort: Neonates born in a tertiary care hospital from whom umbilical cord arterial blood was collected after delivery.
finding: Umbilical cord blood lactate levels were significantly higher in neonates admitted to NICU with birth asphyxia and those requiring resuscitation, with an optimal cutoff of 41.5 mg/dL (4.6 mmol/L) found to be predictive of significant birth asphyxia.
